# AP Remodeling Handyman List — Full Reference

> AP Remodeling Handyman List is a small, owner-run handyman and home remodeling company in Elkhart, Indiana, owned by Charles Poe with 30+ years in business. It serves homeowners in Northern Indiana and Southwest Michigan with handyman repairs, bathroom and kitchen remodeling, flooring installation, siding and window replacement, and roof repair and replacement. Estimates are free.

## About

AP Remodeling Handyman List is a small company owned by Charles Poe in Elkhart, Indiana. Charles's focus is careful workmanship and honoring the product warranties on the materials that go into a home. The company handles small fixes and larger remodels under one phone number, so the tile, the drywall patching and the paint around a new shower are done by the same company instead of three separate contractors. The photos on the website are the company's own job photos: a walk-in shower in large-format marble-look tile with recessed niches, a hexagon mosaic bathroom floor, drywall patched beside new tile, a sloped-ceiling bedroom painted with new baseboard over bare subfloor, and an arched window return finished for paint.

## How an Estimate Works

1. Call (219) 296-5827 or send the estimate form on the website, describing the job and the town the house is in.
2. Pick a weekday estimate visit in a two-hour window.
3. The job is priced after the estimate visit, once the scope and the materials are known. The estimate itself is free and the customer decides whether to go ahead.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Do you offer free estimates?
A: Yes. AP Remodeling Handyman List does not charge to look at a job and price it. Estimate visits are scheduled on weekdays, Monday through Friday, at a time you pick. Call (219) 296-5827 or send the estimate form to set one up.

Q: What kinds of jobs do you take on?
A: AP Remodeling Handyman List handles handyman repairs (drywall, interior and exterior painting, doors, TV mounting, shelving, furniture assembly, fixtures, caulking and weatherproofing, deck and fence repair), bathroom and kitchen remodeling, flooring installation, siding and window replacement, and roof repair and replacement.

Q: Which towns do you serve?
A: AP Remodeling Handyman List is based in Elkhart and works in Mishawaka, South Bend, Osceola, Bristol, Plymouth, Warsaw, Kendallville and Ligonier in Indiana, plus Niles and Edwardsburg in Michigan. If your town is not on the list, call and ask.

Q: How is a job priced?
A: Each job is priced after the estimate visit, once the scope and the materials are known. There is no charge for the estimate itself, and you decide whether to go ahead.

Q: Are you open on weekends?
A: Yes. AP Remodeling Handyman List is open seven days a week, Monday through Sunday, 9 AM to 6 PM. Estimate visits are booked on weekdays.

Q: Can one company handle the tile, drywall and paint on a bathroom remodel?
A: Yes. Bathroom remodeling and the handyman trades are both on the AP Remodeling list, so the tile, the drywall patching and the painting around a new shower are handled by the same company instead of three separate contractors.
